items.label: Lightweight Convertible 2-in-1 Design for Ultimate Portability
items.value: Weighing just under 2.2 pounds, the renewed Lenovo IdeaPad D330-10IGM Laptop is a remarkably portable 2-in-1 device that effortlessly transforms from a compact laptop with its included keyboard to a standalone tablet, making it the perfect travel companion for students, on-the-go note-takers, and casual users.

items.label: Intuitive 10.1-inch Touchscreen Display for Natural Interaction
items.value: Interact naturally with the renewed Lenovo IdeaPad D330-10IGM Touchscreen Laptop using its responsive 10.1-inch touchscreen (1280x800), which is ideal for browsing websites, watching videos, reading e-books, or using touch-friendly applications in tablet mode.

items.label: Essential Connectivity with Modern Ports
items.value: The refurbished Lenovo IdeaPad Laptop D330-10IGM includes practical connectivity options with USB Type-C port for charging and data, USB 2.0 port, 3.5mm audio jack, and microSD card reader for easy storage expansion beyond the built-in 64GB SSD.

items.label: Responsive SSD Storage for Faster Everyday Performance
items.value: Unlike devices with slower eMMC storage, the renewed Lenovo IdeaPad D330-10IGM Tablet features a 64GB Solid State Drive (SSD) for noticeably faster boot times, quicker app launches, and overall snappier system responsiveness during everyday use.

items.label: Complete Package with Included Japanese Keyboard
items.value: The renewed Lenovo IdeaPad D330-10IGM Laptop arrives as a complete package with its attachable Japanese keyboard and power adapter, so you can start using it right out of the box for productivity, learning, or entertainment without any additional purchases.

items.label: Other Special Features of the Product
Compatible Devices
items.value: External storage devices, mice, keyboards, displays (with adapter), Bluetooth headphones, and other standard external devices
